name: Hunter's Mark
description: Mark a creature. You deal an extra 1d6 damage with weapon attacks against it and have advantage on checks to find it. If it drops to 0 hit points, you can move the mark to a new creature as a bonus action.
at_higher_levels: Duration extends to 8 hours at slot level 3 or 4, and 24 hours at level 5 or higher (concentration).
